statement: For two grounded planes z=+-h,v2(r)=(2K/h)sum_(m>=0)K0((2m+1)pi r/(2h)); positive transverse gap gives v2(s)<=exp(-q0(s-r))v2(r). Finite-radius N_max-electron modules obey ||H_AB||<=N_max^2v2(R_AB-2R_mod). Square-lattice incident bound is kappa<=8N_max^2v2(d-2R_mod)/(1-exp(-q0d))^2,with action kappa T_full/hbar. It uses no logical projection/fixed charge/good neighbor. Actual guided-mode electrostatics is H_grounded+[Q-Q_ind(n)]^2/(2C); linear coupling and Q_ind^2/(2C) cannot be chosen independently. The square is gauge-only in exact symmetric idle but matters in active drive and cross-module loading. Finite reservoirs/orbital tails,Robin gap and bus scaling remain explicit physical inputs.
